:py:mod:`futuram.visualisation.make_matter_treemap`
===================================================

.. py:module:: futuram.visualisation.make_matter_treemap

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   make_matter_treemap.py

   This module contains functions for creating treemaps of the matter in a model.

   Functions:
   - make_matter_treemap(data, name, level=0):  Makes a treemap of the matter in the model.
   - prepare_treemap_data(data, parent_key='', level=0): Prepares the data for the treemap.

   Dependencies:
   - plotly

   #! THIS ONE NEEDS WORK: THE NESTED DICTIONARIES SHOULD BE INSIDE OF #! THE OUTSIDE DICTIONARY IN THE BOXES. #! It would be also be good to have an option to choose the level of nesting to display.

.. py:function:: prepare_treemap_data(data, parent_key='', level=0)

   Prepares the data for the treemap.



.. py:function:: make_matter_treemap(data, name, level=0)

   Makes a treemap of the matter in the model.
   Uses the plotly package to make a treemap of the matter composition at all levels in the model.

   :param data: A dictionary of the matter composition at all levels in the model.
   :type data: dict
   :param name: The name of the model.
   :type name: str
   :param level: The level of nesting to display.
   :type level: int

   :returns: None
